name: Quarry
description:
Shows which achievements you can finish on the map you're on, what's left on each, and the nearest objective to walk to. Includes waypoint suggestions, a small Target List, and Hunt mode, which turns on a marker pack's routes for what you're hunting (needs the Pathing module).
Based on Denrage's Achievement Tracker (MIT): https://github.com/Denrage/AchievementTrackerModule

account.details: Needed if you want to automatically track achievement progression.
